source_title: NJDOT Commercial Vehicle Size and Weight Guidebook (January 2024) + Fee Schedule; N.J.A.C. 13:18, N.J.S.A. 39:3-84
verify_reasons: New Jersey publishes NO superload / structural-review threshold — 'Superload' is the name of NJDOT's online permitting system, not a dimensional class; superload_thresholds are null by design (confirmed absent from the January 2024 Commercial Vehicle Size & Weight Guidebook). Loads that would need structural/bridge review are flagged for manual verification with NJDOT.

NJ uses PRIVATE escorts only with no police/State Police escort category, and publishes no height-escort trigger — the escort matrix is width and length only (a height over 14' triggers utility/DOT notification, not an escort).

superload_thresholds.note: New Jersey's January 2024 Commercial Vehicle Size & Weight Guidebook publishes no superload or structural-review threshold; 'Superload' is only the name of NJDOT's online permitting system and contact inbox. All thresholds null by design (handler flags for manual verification). Related caps that do exist: heavy-duty tow combinations 150,000 lbs GCW (N.J.S.A. 39:3-84(c)); axle groups governed by the Federal Bridge Formula; no overweight permit valid where any wheel exceeds 800 lbs per inch of tire width.

width.note: over 14' up to 16' wide: 1 escort — rear on 4+ lane highways, front on under-4-lane (NJ CVG Jan 2024 §5.5 Table 6; private escorts only)
over 16' wide: front + rear escort, plus a 3rd escort (adjacent-lane on 3+ lane highways, else rear); private escorts only — NJ has no police-escort category

length.note: over 100' up to 120': 1 escort — rear on 4+ lane, front on under-4-lane (CVG Table 6)
over 120': front + rear escort plus a 3rd escort

single_trip.fee_formula: Single-trip (valid 5 days): oversize $10 base + $1 per foot (or fraction) over 14' width + $1 per foot over 63' load-length (70' overall for house-related); overweight $10 base + $5 per ton (2,000 lbs, or fraction) over 80,000 lbs gross AND over legal axle limits (22,400 single / 34,000 tandem, 5% axle leeway); combined OS+OW $20 base. All plus a $12 transaction fee + 5% service charge (NJ CVG Jan 2024 / Fee Schedule). Minimum realistic oversize single-trip is about $23 ($10 base + $12 + 5%).
single_trip.note: Emergency permits $0; government-owned vehicles pay only $12 + 5%. Overweight priced on both axle-excess and gross-excess per ton.

annual.note: No general annual OS/OW permit. Code 23 Overweight/Over-dimensional Route Permit (30-day) $0 base + applicable OS/OW fees + $12 + 5% (requires $209.50 annual MVC trailer registration); Annual Ocean-Borne Container Permit $117.60 (max 90,000 lbs); Over-dimensional Trailer lifetime permit $12.60 (invalid if over 10' wide or 70' overall).

movement_restrictions: Oversize: daylight only (sunrise to sunset) where the clear passing space is under 10'; prohibited when visibility is under 500 ft or conditions are hazardous; permit void if the vehicle cannot maintain 40 mph (NJ CVG §5.3).
Overweight loads at legal dimensions may move 24 hours/day, 7 days/week.

Prohibited holidays: New Year's Day; Memorial Day + preceding Friday; Independence Day; Labor Day + preceding Friday; Thanksgiving + preceding Wednesday; Christmas Day. Holiday on Sunday also bans Monday; on Saturday also bans the preceding Friday.

Height over 14': permittee must notify all utilities, NJDOT and county/municipal traffic engineering before the move (N.J.S.A. 39:4-28) — permit void if not done (this is a notification duty, not an escort/pole-car rule).
notes: Legal width 102" (8'6") on National Network/access routes (96" other routes), height 13'6", gross 80,000 lbs; semitrailer 53' on National Network/access routes (48' other). Single axle 22,400 lbs, tandem 34,000 lbs; multi-axle groups per Federal Bridge Formula.

NJ OS/OW permits issued by NJDOT on behalf of NJ MVC under N.J.A.C. 13:18; dimensional/weight limits per N.J.S.A. 39:3-84. All values from the official January 2024 CVG + Fee Schedule (nj.gotpermits.com) fetched 2026-07-16. Escorts are private-only; no superload class or police-escort trigger is published (see verify_reasons). State-level rules only.
